parameters.query:
WITH matched_tx AS (
  SELECT transaction_id
  FROM rag_transactions
  WHERE discord_response_message_id = '{{ $json.discord_response_message_id }}'
  LIMIT 1
),
removed AS (
  DELETE FROM rag_feedback
  WHERE '{{ $json.operation }}' = 'remove'
    AND discord_response_message_id = '{{ $json.discord_response_message_id }}'
    AND feedback_author_id_hash = '{{ $json.feedback_author_id_hash }}'
    AND feedback_source = 'reaction'
    AND feedback_type = '{{ $json.feedback_type }}'
  RETURNING feedback_id, transaction_id
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_feedback (
    transaction_id, discord_response_message_id, feedback_author_id_hash,
    feedback_source, feedback_value, feedback_type, reaction_name, matched,
    review_candidate, review_status, updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    matched_tx.transaction_id, '{{ $json.discord_response_message_id }}',
    '{{ $json.feedback_author_id_hash }}', 'reaction', '{{ $json.feedback_value }}',
    '{{ $json.feedback_type }}', '{{ $json.reaction_name }}',
    matched_tx.transaction_id IS NOT NULL, {{ $json.review_candidate ? 'true' : 'false' }},
    CASE WHEN {{ $json.review_candidate }} THEN 'pending' ELSE NULL END, now()
  FROM (SELECT 1) seed
  LEFT JOIN matched_tx ON true
  WHERE '{{ $json.operation }}' = 'add'
  ON CONFLICT (discord_response_message_id, feedback_author_id_hash, feedback_source)
  DO UPDATE SET
    transaction_id = EXCLUDED.transaction_id,
    feedback_value = EXCLUDED.feedback_value,
    feedback_type = EXCLUDED.feedback_type,
    reaction_name = EXCLUDED.reaction_name,
    matched = EXCLUDED.matched,
    review_candidate = EXCLUDED.review_candidate,
    review_status = EXCLUDED.review_status,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING feedback_id, transaction_id
),
outcome AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT transaction_id FROM upserted LIMIT 1),
             (SELECT transaction_id FROM removed LIMIT 1),
             (SELECT transaction_id FROM matched_tx LIMIT 1)) AS transaction_id,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matched_tx) AS matched,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upserted) THEN 'upserted'
      WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM removed) THEN 'removed'
      ELSE 'no_op'
    END AS persistence_operation
),
trace AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_trace_events (transaction_id, event_name, node_name, status, event_payload)
  SELECT outcome.transaction_id, events.event_name,
    'Apply Feedback Signal', 'completed',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'discord_response_message_id', '{{ $json.discord_response_message_id }}',
      'feedback_source', 'reaction',
      'feedback_type', '{{ $json.feedback_type }}',
      'feedback_value', '{{ $json.feedback_value }}',
      'event_kind', '{{ $json.event_kind }}',
      'persistence_operation', outcome.persistence_operation,
      'review_candidate', {{ $json.review_candidate ? 'true' : 'false' }}
    )
  FROM outcome
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('feedback.received'::text),
    (CASE WHEN outcome.matched THEN 'feedback.linked' ELSE 'feedback.unmatched' END)
  ) events(event_name)
  RETURNING event_id
),
review_trace AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_trace_events (transaction_id, event_name, node_name, status, event_payload)
  SELECT transaction_id, 'feedback.review_flagged', 'Apply Feedback Signal', 'decision',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'discord_response_message_id', '{{ $json.discord_response_message_id }}',
      'feedback_source', 'reaction',
      'feedback_type', '{{ $json.feedback_type }}'
    )
  FROM outcome
  WHERE {{ $json.review_candidate ? 'true' : 'false' }}
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT outcome.*,
  '{{ $json.discord_response_message_id }}'::text AS discord_response_message_id,
  '{{ $json.feedback_type }}'::text AS feedback_type,
  '{{ $json.feedback_value }}'::text AS feedback_value,
  {{ $json.review_candidate ? 'true' : 'false' }}::boolean AS review_candidate,
  (SELECT event_id FROM trace LIMIT 1) AS trace_event_id
FROM outcome;

const state = $items('Build Feedback Trace')[0].json;
return [{ json: { accepted: true, matched: state.matched, transaction_id: state.transaction_id || null, discord_response_message_id: state.discord_response_message_id, persistence_operation: state.persistence_operation, review_candidate: state.review_candidate, event_name: state.event_name } }];
